observations.why: The act of switching to a new database technology appeals to novelty and self-direction as the motivating good.
Performance gain and cost reduction appeal to achievement and mastery of craft as the motivating goods.
The migration arrow frames adopting the new technology as the appealed-to good, carrying the same openness-to-change signal as the spoken source.
Quantified performance gain appeals to mastery and achievement as the motivating goods.
A concrete timeline signals capability to deliver on the migration, appealing to competence as the motivating good.
